title: Ambient completion presentations for integral pullback and tensor
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=A/t^nA$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On the small pro-etale site of each $W=X,Y$, put $R_W=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use $D(R_W)$, the unbounded derived category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $F_f:D(R_Y)\to D(R_X)$ be ordinary ambient derived module pullback along the canonical ring map $f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$, induced by the finite quotient projections [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback]. Put
$$C_WQ=R\lim_n\operatorname{Res}_n(Q\otimes_{R_W}^{\mathbf L}(A_n)_W),$$
with its quotient augmentation and strict-tower derived limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Let $\widehat F_f$ and $\widehat T_W$ be precisely the finite-quotient definitions of integral pullback and completed tensor in [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Then for all $K\in D(R_Y)$ and $M,N\in D(R_W)$ there are natural isomorphisms
$$C_XF_fK\xrightarrow{\sim}\widehat F_fK,\qquad C_W(M\otimes_{R_W}^{\mathbf L}N)\xrightarrow{\sim}\widehat T_W(M,N).$$
On flat-term K-flat representatives $P\to K$ and $U\to M,V\to N$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], these are the derived limits of the isomorphisms of entire strict towers
$$(f^*P)\otimes_{R_X}(A_n)_X\cong f_n^*(P\otimes_{R_Y}(A_n)_Y),$$
$$\operatorname{Tot}(U\otimes_{R_W}V)\otimes_{R_W}(A_n)_W\cong\operatorname{Tot}((U\otimes_{R_W}(A_n)_W)\otimes_{(A_n)_W}(V\otimes_{R_W}(A_n)_W)),$$
where $\operatorname{Tot}$ is the direct-sum total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves].
The maps are the balanced tensor associativity maps and identify the quotient augmentations with the defining operation augmentations, including their zero shifted-product component. They commute with all quotient transitions and with changes of the K-flat representatives. No identification $f^{-1}R_Y=R_X$ and no completeness or constructibility assumption is required.

Completion-unit naturality gives both augmentations. The fully constructed public operation record is shared through proved literal equality, preserving its comparisons and units. B4 proves the remaining pullTowerModel through the normalized scalar adjunction, uniqueness of left adjoints, and the actual quotient-transition generator formulas. Its self-contained pullback presentation is in NormalizedIntegralPullbackTower and is publicly reexported with unchanged names, signatures, definition bodies and attributes. The restricted-map extensionality argument is abstracted over arbitrary rings to avoid unfolding completed limits; profiling and the per-file limit motivate isolating the proved support module. Tensor and derived comparison proofs remain unchanged. No new hole, Challenge statement change, or adopted source-library change is made. The independent cochain interface keeps semilinear implementation instances private; quarantined consumers and their DAG attachments remain untouched.

theorem integralAmbientOperationModels {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (_hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (_hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ∃ (F : ambientD l E Y ⥤
        ambientD l E X)
      (ε : modelQ l E Y ⋙ F ⟶ modelPullComplex l E f ⋙ modelQ l E X)
      (α : F ⋙ modelCompletion l E X ≅ modelPull l E f),
      F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
        (ambientQuasiIso l E Y) ∧
      (∀ P : (ambientGood l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        IsIso (ε.app P.obj)) ∧
      (∀ P : (ambientGood l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        α.hom.app ((modelGoodLocalization l E Y).obj P) ≫
            (modelPullComparison l E f).hom.app P =
          (modelCompletion l E X).map (ε.app P.obj) ≫
            (modelCompletionComparison l E X).hom.app
              ((modelPullGoodLift l E f).obj P) ≫
            modelPullTowerMap l E f P.obj) ∧
      (∀ P : (ambientGood l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        (modelCompletionUnit l E X).app (F.obj ((modelGoodLocalization l E Y).obj P)) ≫
            α.hom.app ((modelGoodLocalization l E Y).obj P) ≫
            (modelPullComparison l E f).hom.app P =
          ε.app P.obj ≫ modelPullUnitMap l E f P.obj) ∧
      ∀ W : Scheme.{t}, W = X ∨ W = Y →
        ∃ β : (modelOrdinaryTensor l E W) ⋙
            modelCompletion l E W ≅ modelCompletedTensor l E W,
          (∀ P Q : (ambientGood l E W).FullSubcategory,
            β.hom.app
              (((modelGoodLocalization l E W).prod (modelGoodLocalization l E W)).obj (P, Q)) ≫
                (modelTensorComparison l E W).hom.app (P, Q) =
              (modelCompletion l E W).map
                (tensorRepresentative l E W P Q).inv ≫
              (modelCompletionComparison l E W).hom.app
                ((modelTensorGoodLift l E W).obj (P, Q)) ≫
              modelTensorTowerMap l E W P.obj Q.obj) ∧
          (∀ P Q : (ambientGood l E W).FullSubcategory,
            (modelCompletionUnit l E W).app
                ((modelOrdinaryTensor l E W).obj
                  (((modelGoodLocalization l E W).prod (modelGoodLocalization l E W)).obj (P, Q))) ≫
                β.hom.app
              (((modelGoodLocalization l E W).prod (modelGoodLocalization l E W)).obj (P, Q)) ≫
                (modelTensorComparison l E W).hom.app (P, Q) =
              (tensorRepresentative l E W P Q).inv ≫
                modelTensorUnitMap l E W P.obj Q.obj)
